notes.compatibility: The archived Pine v4 file declares an indicator but includes two explicit broker-entry branches. A strategy declaration enables those existing orders. The v4 tostring spelling and the two inert, comment-only visual guards are repaired. Swing and MACD display logic contributes no price gate to the authored order branches.
notes.timing: The active 240-minute EMA series uses the same four-hour chart and known closed bars. April 16 through May 2 provides price-only warmup, and both order branches become eligible at the saved May 3 start. The terminal quarter-hour includes its 14 confirmed minutes through the 23:59 UTC cutoff. No fill after the saved end is included.
notes.verification: An independent 20/50 EMA implementation and open-price broker reproduced each trace, reversal and realized lot. Active fills use positive-volume official first 15m children. Starting capital and one fixed base unit follow the native defaults. Fees use a 0.075% per-side unchanged-fill overlay.

coverage: Tested · Restored original Pine trend-order branches

Resolved the indicator/order declaration conflict without inventing signal gates. Independently verified both EMA curves, fixed-source order direction, the original minute cutoff, four closed lots and two unsettled positions.
